summary: Completed testing of Versione Lite security features. All 17 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified - login shows 'Nome Lite', minor dashboard displays first_name + surname initial + emoji + color correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Versione Lite security features fully tested. Martina (id: 3d7df7a283444a2c83483d33) has nome_lite='MartinaG', lite_color='#E91E63', lite_emoji='🏐'. Login works with nome_lite (case insensitive) or athlete_code fallback. Progressive blocking activates after 3 failed attempts (30s block). Attendance/check uses qr_identifier NOT nome_lite.

minor_login_with_nome_lite.details: Login with nome_lite 'MartinaG' + PIN works. Case insensitive (martinag, MARTINAG both work). Fallback to athlete_code also works.

progressive_blocking.details: After 3 failed attempts, 429 response with 'Troppi tentativi' message. Progressive blocking: 3=30s, 5=2min, 7=5min, 10+=15min

set_nome_lite_endpoint.details: Validates 3-20 chars, rejects duplicates (409 conflict), parent can set for their athlete

set_lite_personalization.details: Minor can set lite_color and lite_emoji. Parent cannot (403). Both color and emoji can be set together.

minor_dashboard_lite_fields.details: Dashboard returns nome_lite, lite_color, lite_emoji, first_name, last_name. UI shows 'Ciao, Martina G.' with emoji and color.

attendance_uses_qr_identifier.details: Attendance/check endpoint uses qr_identifier, athlete_code, or id - NOT nome_lite. nome_lite lookup returns 404.

login_page_nome_lite_label.details: Login page shows 'Nome Lite' placeholder and 'Accedi con Nome Lite e PIN' subtitle instead of 'Codice Atleta'

parent_athlete_page_credentials.details: Parent athlete page shows 'Nome Lite:' credential display with option to set/modify
